title: PostgreSQL SQLAlchemy Core upsert pattern
content: PostgreSQL supports INSERT ... ON CONFLICT for upsert behavior. In SQLAlchemy Core, import the PostgreSQL insert function with: from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert. Then call stmt.on_conflict_do_update(index_elements=['email'], set_={'last_seen': stmt.excluded.last_seen}). Do not import on_conflict_do_update as a function. Do not build raw SQL with f-strings.

title: Use explicit timeouts with requests and httpx
content: For production Python HTTP calls, use explicit timeouts. Avoid unbounded requests.get or httpx.get calls in data pipelines because stuck network calls can block Airflow tasks, batch jobs, or workers.

title: Db2 for i and Db2 LUW are separate targets
content: Treat Db2 for i, also called IBM i or AS400 in many legacy environments, as distinct from Db2 LUW. Do not assume syntax, services, catalog views, or operational behavior are identical without version-specific documentation.
